subject.reason: v4 is the recommendation: an effect box drawn as apparatus (valve, tape loop, spring tank, follower lever), so every control moves a real part, and it is the furthest from toro and theseus.
subject.chosenBy: Claude, on the owner's behalf (owner answered: no preference)
subject.subject: A cutaway schematic of one box: a gain valve the playing passes through, a tape loop with a moving playback head for the echoes, and a coil spring tank for the room, linked by a single lever from the level follower that dips the tape and spring outputs while playing.
controls: Squeeze: the valve's gate closes across the signal path, from fully open to a narrow slot.
Echo: the playback head slides along the tape away from the record head; the distance is the note length, and more loops of tape show as repeats grow; at 0 the head lifts off.
Space: the spring stretches and gains coils, from a short stub to a long tank.
Blend: the follower's lever tips further while playing, pressing the tape and spring outputs down; it lifts in the gaps.
Tone: a damper pad moves onto the spring and tape, from touching hard (dark) to clear and then a thin felt (bright).
Motion: the tape's guide roller swings, wavering the tape path.
Dry: a bypass link from input to output thickens from absent to full width.
Attack: the lever's spring: a stiff short spring at fast attack, a long soft one at slow.
Order (Shift): the valve slides from before the tape and spring to after them on the path.
subject.reference: library/theseus-tower (geometric line drawing of real apparatus), P1 Section drawing (MNMD MD KIT)
subject.risks: Many parts to fit in 480 x 220 at legible weights; three mechanisms may compete for the brightest element.
